page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfc6.20xlarge is a compute-optimized bare-metal instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.4 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high core count and dedicated CPU allocation paired with a lower memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is structured for compute-intensive workloads that require consistent CPU performance without massive memory footprints. It is suitable for high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, and large-scale web serving.
